criteria.name: Info and relationships
criteria.evidence: source: a native label element with htmlFor; axe passes on all 3 stories
criteria.note: The tie only works when the caller passes htmlFor and the control has that id (see Input and Select).

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast passes on all 3 stories: #596B7A on white 5.5:1

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll; LongContent wraps

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: axe and keyboard run: no interactive element, Tab finds nothing to focus
